You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])

    occ=set(); res=[[0]*W for _ in g]
    for c in Cs:
        v=g[c[0][0]][c[0][1]]
        found=False
        # try columns from rightmost to leftmost, rows from topmost
        for bc in range(W-1,max(b for _,b in c),-1):
            for ar in range(min(a for a,_ in c),max(a for a,_ in c)+1):

                    found=True;break

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    Cs=comps_of(g)
    S=[c for c in Cs if len(c)==1]
    M=[c for c in Cs if len(c)>1]
    # order: singles by scan, then multis by size desc then scan
    S.sort(key=lambda c:(min(a for a,_ in c),max(b for _,b in c)))
    M.sort(key=lambda c:(-len(c),min(a for a,_ in c),min(b for _,b in c)))
    occ=set(); res=[[0]*W for _ in g]
    for c in S+M:
        v=g[c[0][0]][c[0][1]]
        for k in range(W-1-max(b for _,b in c),-1,-1):
            if all((a,b+k) not in occ and 0<=b+k<W for a,b in c):
                for a,b in c: occ.add((a,b+k)); res[a][b+k]=v
                break
        assert k is not None
    return res

def f2(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    Cs=comps_of(g)
    occ=set(); res=[[0]*W for _ in g]
    # order: multis first sorted by... try largest-last-first
    M=[c for c in Cs if len(c)>1]; S=[c for c in Cs if len(c)==1]
    M.sort(key=lambda c:(max(a for a,_ in c),min(b for _,b in c)))   # bottom-most FIRST

                if (x,y) in occ: ok=False;break
            if ok:
                for a,b in c: occ.add((a,b+k)); res[a][b+k]=v
                break
    return res

# Derive exact per-component translations in demo1 & demo2 outputs.
def disp(i,o):
    Ci=comps_of(i); Co=[set(c) for c in comps_of(o)]
    res=[]
    for c in Ci:
        col=i[c[0][0]][c[0][1]]
        placed=None
        for cc in Co:
            if len(cc)==len(c) and all(o[a][b]==col for a,b in cc):
                # translation check
                v=(cc[0][0]-c[0][0], cc[0][1]-c[0][1])
                if all((a+v[0],b+v[1]) in cc for a,b in c): placed=v;break
        res.append((col,v))
    return res

import os,glob,re,json
def loadp(p):
    t=open(p, errors='ignore').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
def comps(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j] and not seen[i][j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; cells=[]
                while st:
                    r,c=st.pop(); cells.append((r,c))
                    for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                        if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and g[nr][nc] and not seen[nr][nc]:
                            seen[nr][nc]=True; st.append((nr,nc))
                out.append(cells)
    return out
def f(gin):
    H,W=len(gin),len(gin[0])
    cs=comps(gin)
    # order: bottom-most row desc, then max col desc
    cs.sort(key=lambda cl:(max(r for r,c in cl), max(c for r,c in cl)), reverse=True)
    placed=[]  # list of (cells, orig_cells)
    res=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for cl in cs:
        mr=max(r for r,c in cl); mc=max(c for r,c in cl)
        sr=min(r for r,c in cl); sc=min(c for r,c in cl)
        hgt=max(r for r,c in cl)-sr+1; wid=max(c for r,c in cl)-sc+1
        # slide right until overlap or out of bounds
        s=0
        while True:
            nxt=[(r, c+s) for r,c in cl]
            if any(c>=W for _,c in nxt): break
            if any(res[r][c] for r,c in nxt): break
            s+=1
        s-=1
        for r,c in cl: res[r][c+s]=gin[r][c]
    return res
